purpose: Register a strictly paired accuracy screen for the opt-in static ACF reliability interpolation candidate.
research_question: Does a single bounded per-channel/horizon interpolation between aggregate and legally available train-prior ACF strength improve or preserve forecast accuracy without adding a dense forecast path?
evidence_boundary: This is an unauthorized exploratory H96 screen on ETTh1 and traffic with three seeds per arm. It is candidate-selection evidence only, not confirmatory or publication evidence.
claim_boundary: Only paired descriptive scaled-MSE deltas, seed dispersion, diagnostics, and pre-registered resource comparisons may be reported. Test metrics cannot select the architecture, and no universal Mamba or ACF claim is allowed.

required_before_launch: human review of the two-dataset, H96, three-seed scope
confirm the static raw train-prior and current source/environment hashes
freeze this JSON and create an approved launch sidecar
confirm that test metrics will not be used for architecture selection

prelaunch_gates: human review of the two-dataset, H96, three-seed scope
confirm the static raw train-prior and current source/environment hashes
freeze this JSON and create an approved launch sidecar
confirm that test metrics will not be used for architecture selection

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, interpolation arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use a fresh output root and retain the runner source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, config hashes, manifest, ACF prior, and phase validation. Do not copy historical metrics or checkpoints into this matrix.

phases.name: reliability_off_h96
phases.purpose: Current static raw-prior MambaACFAutoCon reference with the interpolation scalar disabled.

phases.name: reliability_on_h96
phases.purpose: The same reference with only the zero-initialized per-channel/horizon reliability interpolation enabled.

planned_contrasts: reliability_on_h96 minus reliability_off_h96 under identical training, scales, relation loss, and raw static ACF prior
comparison_contract.resource_reference: new resource benchmark required; do not reuse the old signature because the architecture schema now includes this flag
stopping_rules: Do not expand to additional datasets or horizons until all 12 jobs finish and paired seed manifests are complete.
Do not promote the interpolation arm if pooled paired MSE worsens by more than 1 percent or if either dataset worsens on all three seeds.
Treat a favorable result with a wide seed spread or a scale parameter near zero as exploratory and repeat only after human review.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This screen can assess a low-capacity ACF memory refinement; it cannot establish a general accuracy, speed, or representation-learning claim.
